conventions: C1 Inline.runs are complete and verbatim: renderer writes them as-is and adds no label/prefix (applies to SourceLine.inline incl. 'SUMBER  '/'PROVENANS', keyRow incl. 'KUNCI  ', derivation.title incl. 'Turunan D-x.y · ', RailLine.runs incl. glyph and mark label, aside/monoBlock label).
C2 Caption = label + separator + inline.runs; label run uses labelProps.
C3 Section heading = number (numberRun) + title.runs; the BM separator '   ' is the first title run (RunProps of the number run), no extra separator is added (gap G-01).
C4 List item = marker run + w:tab (marker props) + runs.

C5 PartSpec order = sealBand/spacer/datumRule from body[] -> label -> title -> lede -> chapter list (showChapterList: label = chapter kicker text, title = chapter title text, cell formats from roles U46/U47) (gap G-02).
C6 TocSpec order = sealBand -> kicker -> title -> entries table (3 cols) -> note.
C7 SignatureBlock rows = role row, sign row (signRowFormat, empty), holder row (gap G-03).
C8 derivation (render.derivation.renderer = nestedTable): cell = title, [intro], nested lines table, empty <w:p/> (KT-19), closing; line value = value.runs + glyph run of `mark` (glyphRun U65).
C9 Rail paragraph (render.rail.renderer = table3col): prose cell, empty spacer cell (KT-19), rail cell with one paragraph per RailLine (runs verbatim).

C10 Chapter: kicker -> datumRule (asset rule128, derived; figure ids bm-fig-* in x.figures) -> title -> intro -> sections; one sectPr holder paragraph (empty, no pPr) closes every unit except the last (KS-06).
C11 Figure blocks are `image` blocks with asset = x.figureRef = bm-fig-NN; S94 resolves bm-fig-NN to a chart/diagram spec or a raster asset with the same sha256 (D-14).
C12 Explicit `format`/RunProps on blocks, cells and runs win over template roleFormats (KS-07 resolution order).
C13 Cell.widthTw / layout.widthTw = the LAST w:tcW / w:tblW of BM (both values kept in the trace, GS-01).
C14 Unit order = cover, controlSheet, toc, then per part: the part followed by the chapters whose partId is that part, then appendices; every unit is one sectPr (KS-06).
gaps: G-01 Section has no number separator field: BM writes '1.1   ' (3 spaces) in the Mono number run; closest = leading title run with the number RunProps. Proposal: Section.numberSeparator?: string (or param render.section.numberSeparator).

G-02 PartSpec: order of body[] relative to label/title/lede/chapter list is not defined by §3.3. Proposal: document order body[] -> label -> title -> lede -> chapter list, or PartSpec.bodyAfter?: FrontItem[].
G-03 SignatureBlock: row order (role, sign space, holder) is not defined. Proposal: fix order in spec (BM T008: role, sign, holder) or SignatureBlock.rowOrder.

G-04 Cell paragraphs vs nested table order is not expressible (Cell.paragraphs + Cell.nested); BM derivations put the nested table between title and closing. Covered by DerivationBlock; generic Cell has no ordering field.
G-05 Spec §13.2 maps KT-34 to derivation.intro but in BM (T034, T050) the KT-34 paragraph comes AFTER the nested lines table -> mapped to derivation.closing (intro absent).

G-06 Inline-only fields carry no ParaFormat (chapter kicker/title, part label/title/lede, toc kicker/title/note, keyRow, aside/monoBlock/derivation labels, ControlBlock/Colophon/sealBand/TOC/registerBlock cells): their paragraph and cell formats come from template roles only (S95).
G-07 HeaderFooterSpec has no style reference: BM header/footer paragraphs use pStyle Header/Footer.

G-08 registerBlock cannot express the footer table's cell borders/margins/paragraph formats nor the empty paragraph after the table (BM footer5..29: pStyle Footer, line 20 exact); these come from template render.section.interior (R-10).
